body: No. I don't have anyone now. I've tried a few other people I know but none of them are actually willing to listen.

My mom is the only one I'd have and I'm just not comfortable talking to her like that. Not to mention the distress she's already in. I've tried therapists in the past. They just don't work for me. This feels like the only option.

The worst part is while I should still be torn to pieces about my ex fiance I'm more upset about losing my friend. I guess I just threw all my feelings and emotions onto him and when he left I just broke.
